services.desc: The main campground is open for the 2026 season. We have 6 sites First Come, First Served sites. Please see link to book your site. Open year-round, Kilby Park is situated in beautiful Harrison Mills-a quiet corner of the Fraser Valley located at the confluence of the Fraser and Harrison rivers. The park features a family-oriented 41-site campground (for tents and RVs), a day-use area, sandy beaches, nature trails, and a boat launch. Basic facilities include pit toilets, picnic tables, fire pits, and potable water. The park is at the west end of Kilby Road, within walking distance of the Kilby Historic Site.
